URL Encoder / Decoder

URL-encode or decode text, choosing between full-URL encoding and component encoding, with errors on malformed input.


  

  
Full URL encoding keeps : / ? & # intact; component encoding encodes everything except a few safe characters. Runs entirely in your browser.




  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Paste the text or URL into the input box.
  2. Pick Full URL or Component encoding mode.
  3. Click Encode or Decode.
  4. Copy the result to your clipboard.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What is the difference between full URL and component encoding?
Full URL (encodeURI) keeps URL structure characters like : / ? & intact, while Component (encodeURIComponent) encodes everything except a few safe characters — use it for query values.
What happens with malformed input when decoding?
Decoding malformed percent-sequences throws a URIError, which the tool catches and shows as a friendly error message.
Does this work offline?
Yes — all encoding and decoding happens locally in your browser.
